selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline state before repair (original ownership/contents of /srv/inventory)
selected_evidence.summary: Showed /srv/inventory owned by root:root, files present (records.csv, config.json) with original content, confirming no user/group existed yet

selected_evidence.requirement: Data ownership set to inventorysvc, group inventory-readers, others excluded, contents preserved
selected_evidence.summary: Created inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group, chowned tree, set dirs 750/files 640, and verified resulting listing plus readable file content (2 records) matching original data
As user 'nobody' (unrelated to inventory-readers), both cat and ls on /srv/inventory/data returned Permission denied

Backgrounded sudo reboot command dispatched and acknowledged ('reboot command dispatched') before the node went unreachable

selected_evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart (node1)
selected_evidence.summary: Node1 responded again with boot_id c39f862c-89c6-4e26-94b5-71a08241f333 and uptime 0 minutes, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving a real reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required permissions, data, and access control on node1
selected_evidence.summary: After restart, /srv/inventory still owned by inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750/640 modes, file contents unchanged, inventorysvc could read both files, and 'nobody' was still denied access

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== create group inventory-readers =="
sudo -n addgroup inventory-readers 2>&1 || true
echo "== create system user inventorysvc =="
sudo -n adduser -S -D -H -s /sbin/nologin -G inventory-readers inventorysvc 2>&1 || true

echo "== ownership: inventorysvc:inventory-readers, recursive =="
sudo -n chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory

echo "== permissions: dirs 750 (rwx r-x ---), files 640 (rw- r-- ---) =="
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type d -exec chmod 750 {} \;
sudo -n find /srv/inventory -type f -exec chmod 640 {} \;

echo "== VERIFY =="
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers
find /srv/inventory -exec ls -ld {} \;
echo "== data preserved =="
cat /srv/inventory/data/records.csv 2>&1 | sudo -n -u inventorysvc cat /srv/inventory/data/records.csv 2>&1 || true
